gen-tourney-gf-preahvihear: Stretched, stubby, built like a scoreboard. Tourney cuts every stroke to one width, while Preahvihear is a sans with a lofty x-height and open mouths that keep long paragraphs easy to move through.
gen-tourney-gf-prompt: Approachable is the first word for Prompt, with its oversized small letters and apertures that stay open. And Tourney, cut at one flat width and tracked wide, gives it a bold, athletic header to sit under.
gen-tourney-gf-puritan: Approachable and rounded, Puritan keeps its forms open to the side. Puritan's oversized e and a counters make it the sans that softens Tourney's flat, bulky, wide-tracked lettering into something friendly.
gen-tourney-gf-sintony: Wide, bulky, athletic: that's Tourney. Sintony's chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves are the strongest card here, a sans that stays clear where the heading's single-width strokes go heavy.
gen-tourney-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed has lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, plus big visible entrances into its curves. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads smoothly in a sans, while Tourney stretches wide above it.
gen-tourney-gf-sono: Sono leans on tall lowercase and wide default spacing, with each a left slightly ajar. And Tourney, bold and athletic at a single stroke width, gives that sans a heavy, stretched-out headline to lean against.
gen-tourney-gf-stack-sans-notch: Neutral and rod-straight, Stack Sans Notch lets you see right into its open curves. Tourney's wide-tracked, single-width heading makes a sturdy contrast, and the big-bodied sans text keeps going comfortably.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sulphur-point: Commanding Wallpoet has paper showing through between its letters and almost no stroke contrast. And Sulphur Point follows in sans-serif, with a marker-like line and open gaps that keep a long read smooth.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-tiktok-sans: Expressive, stretched, and brushy, Warnes tapers each stroke out. TikTok Sans, a modern sans with lowercase rising close to cap height, reads with a roomy, steady ease across many lines.
gen-irish-grover-gf-ubuntu-sans: Fun and organic, Irish Grover brings tall, sturdy lowercase with a soft, brushed shift in stroke. Ubuntu Sans does the opposite job, a plain sans of tubular, unshaded strokes with big, open eyes.
